data: A large block of limestone reused in a later (Hellenistic) wall, near the SW gate of the Hellenistic city. The block tapers in both dimensions, and is very worn. The text begins on the front face and continues on the left side face.
Found in 1953 in re-use in the Hellenistic wall near the SW gate.
